name: Enigma
bio: Archetype: Dynamo, Bastion, Control Immunity. ⌽ Deploys [Pulsing Field] at turn start if it isn't already active. Injects 10 [Dynamo] into [Pulsing Field] at turn end. ⌽ Stacks [Loop Chain] for every ally active action / hit taken / turn end. When able, consume 5 stacks and grant 1 Moxie, [Dynamo], [Bastion] to self and 5 [Ciphertext] to all allies. ⌽ [Ciphertext] is consumed when injecting [Dynamo] to make [Pulsing Field] gain extra [Dynamo]. Cap of 6/7/10 for 1/2/3+ [Dynamo] allies. ⌽ [Bastion] cannot coexist with [Shield]. Damage dealt to allies hits [Bastion] instead, and allies take less damage and gain Control immunity. ⌽ Ally [Dynamo] cap increased by 20 and gain damage buffs for every [Dynamo] under lv.3 [Pulsing Field]. ⌽ Ultimate does not count towards draw limit, cleanses all negative effects from allies, grants Crit DMG and DMG Bonus.
